mechanism_narrative: Sustained increase in CPIAUCSL (inflation) signals rising inflation expectations, leading to market uncertainty and negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year window, or 20-day forward returns in inflationary phases are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained UNRATE crossing above 4.0% signals a strong labor market, boosting growth expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite UNRATE exceeding 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS rises (tightening) alongside INDPRO falling (supply contraction), this dual signal of monetary tightening and reduced supply capacity triggers negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: The combination does not correlate with negative returns in 60-day windows, or Rank IC > 0.03 over any 3-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in GDPC1 (demand growth) signals robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite GDPC1's rise.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in INDPRO below 110.0 (supply contraction) signals weak production capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) despite INDPRO falling below 110.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in FEDFUNDS (tightening) and UNRATE decline (higher unemployment) creates a contractionary environment, driving negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: The interaction does not correlate with negative returns in 60-day windows, or Rank IC > 0.03 over any 3-year period.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, sustained FEDFUNDS declines (easing) persistently lower discount rates, boosting equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 returns within 5 days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) during late-cycle easing periods.

mechanism_narrative: Rising CPIAUCSL (inflation) alongside FEDFUNDS increases creates conflicting signals of inflation and tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: The combined effect does not correlate with negative returns in 60-day windows, or Rank IC > 0.03 over any 3-year period.
